noisefloor-3x.notes: 15/15 collected 2026-08-10 ~09:30. R0 mean 0.674 SD 0.278, 2/15 R0>=1, 5/15 extinct, 8/15 hit plant cap. Cap-binding 53%. PRE-REGISTERED COMPARISON RESOLVED: 3x vs 5x mean difference -0.061, SE 0.108, permutation p=0.590, Fisher p=1.000 on hit rate; gap is 1/5 of one noise-floor SD (threshold 0.314). By the pre-registered rule 5x is NOT promoted, 3x stands on parsimony. ALSO: 15/15 runs in BOTH arms fail the stationarity gate (median slopes 10-25x the DRIFTING threshold) -- no R0 here is an equilibrium measurement. See LEDGER.md 'The pre-registered 3x-vs-5x comparison RESOLVES'.

intake-regulation-probe.prediction_ref: LEDGER.md 'New diagnostic: is aRate/aUpkeep an emergent equilibrium or a parameter?'
intake-regulation-probe.notes: PREMISE WITHDRAWN (emergent-regulation hypothesis rejected, see LEDGER). 2/3 collected: seed 1337 R0 0.56 EXTINCT; seed 4001 R0 0.78 SURVIVED (N~58-86 at end), aRate/aUpkeep 1.13 (BELOW corpus mean 1.166 despite +50% k_intake). The 'reliably drives extinction' reframing is ALSO not supported -- 1/2 extinctions matches the 5/15 (33%) base rate from the cold noise-floor sample. Paired vs same-seed base dose: 1337 1.21->0.56, 4001 1.03->0.78, both negative, mean -0.45 vs noise SD ~0.3. Suggestive but n=2; seed 4002 running.

stationarity-ladder.prediction_ref: LEDGER.md 'Stationarity ladder -- prediction, written before the run'
stationarity-ladder.notes: 2400-day run. Single long run yields the 800/1600/2400 ladder because run length is a loop bound, not an RNG input -- and the run self-verifies that assumption: the day-600-800 window must reproduce the known 800-day R0 1.21 for this seed/cfg, else the design is discarded. HIT = |R0(2400)-R0(800)|>0.31 AND slope shrinks (protocol too short). MISS = windows agree within 0.31 AND slopes stay large (systems never settle; 800d as good as any). seed 1337 running (d960/2400 at ~10:45); seed 4001 fired ~11:00 on the core freed by base-dose 30002.
